name: Karamat Ali Jaunpuri
contribution: He preached reformist Islam across Bengal and North India, linking local Muslim debate to wider Waliullahi and Tariqah-i-Muhammadiya currents.
context: In nineteenth-century Bengal, his preaching operated amid religious controversy, rural reform, and new Muslim public argument under colonial rule.
impact: He helps connect Bengal's reform debates with wider North Indian Islamic networks.
highlight: A bridge between Bengal's Muslim reform debates and North Indian revivalist networks.
